projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Java and Spring Boot service with a MySQL schema for booking study rooms; piloted for 2 weeks with 120 students and removed double bookings.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to track order status, run locally with Docker Compose.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with Data Structures and Algorithms through competitive programming or LeetCode; the JD emphasises these as core competencies.

Study Distributed Systems concepts (eventual consistency, consensus, partitioning, replication) and implement a small project demonstrating one pattern, such as a distributed cache or message queue consumer.
Deepen Object-Oriented Design knowledge by refactoring your projects to showcase design patterns (Factory, Observer, Strategy) and document them in your project descriptions.
Add a project or contribution that explicitly demonstrates scalable system design, such as a load-balanced API or a service handling concurrent requests with proper synchronisation.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid full-stack fundamentals, but the JD prioritises Data Structures, Algorithms, Distributed Systems and Object-Oriented Design — none of which are evident in your current profile. Gaining these will significantly improve your fit for this role.
